message.content:
Let \(x\) be the number of students who take physics. Then the number who take chemistry is \(2x\).

Students taking at least one subject:

\[
360 - 15 = 345
\]

Using inclusion-exclusion:

\[
|C \cup P \cup H| = |C| + |P| + |H| - |C\cap P| - |C\cap H| - |P\cap H| + |C\cap P\cap H|
\]

Substitute the given values:

\[
345 = 180 + x + 2x - 30 - 75 - 75 + 15
\]

Simplify:

\[
345 = 3x + 15
\]

\[
3x = 330
\]

\[
x = 110
\]

The answer is 110.
